name: Internet Health Pro
release_gate: one shared monitoring engine per plugin process
native ICMP latency with honest TCP-connect, DNS lookup and HTTPS response timing labels
multi-signal outage detection with two-cycle confirmation
ICMP-blocked network fallback without false 100% probe loss
user-adjustable latency, jitter and probe-loss thresholds
manual-only warmed adaptive throughput test capped at approximately 80 MB per run
clean Windows and macOS live network smoke
official Elgato Stream Deck CLI validation
deterministic Rat Art and marketplace kit preflight
final_boundary: Re-run Rat Dev on physical Stream Deck and verify: Property Inspector live status replaces Starting monitor, settings persist after closing/reopening, Probe Now and Run Speed Test buttons visibly execute, the larger key typography is readable at normal distance, the 30-second graph remains useful, and the longer multi-stream speed test is credible against a known connection.
qa_note: Latest physical QA found a real Property Inspector transport bug: Internet Health used actionInfo.context for setSettings/sendToPlugin while the already-fixed Monitor Manager Pro uses the Property Inspector UUID. That mismatch explains stale 'Starting monitor…', dead PI buttons, and settings that did not persist. This candidate switches all PI action messages to the PI UUID, adds save/button feedback, substantially enlarges and simplifies physical-key typography, preserves the 30-second graph, and lengthens the manual Cloudflare multi-stream speed measurement to a bounded ~300 MB maximum for fast links. Automation must pass again, then physical hardware QA is required.

profiles.reason: Internet Health Pro is a standalone utility and does not promise a bundled dashboard profile. PackRat bundles profiles when layout is part of the product promise, such as Voice Deck and Valorant Tracker.

upsell.note: Do not invent a Lite counterpart. net-spike remains explicitly classified as a standalone free XENEON network probe, not an Internet Health Lite edition.
